faqs.q: What if my internal premise plumbing is galvanized too?
faqs.a: If a copper pipe is connected to a galvanized line, a dielectric junction must be installed to reduce the potential for corrosion. It is recommended that internal galvanized lines be updated as well. The City's program is not replacing internal premise plumbing, this would be at the cost of the property owner.
